scene: The red lever rumbles, opening pneumatic tubes with a swoosh!
picture: Flat side-view slice along a level wooden floor line in Pigeon Post Tower. Left, a circular iron hatch stands popped open. Center, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands holding the pulled red lever. Up high, a green capsule emerges from a brass tube. Far right, an open hatch holds a sturdy wooden ladder.
shown: a glowing green capsule popping out from a metal pipe up high
a circular iron sorting hatch swung wide open on the left
a sturdy wooden ladder leading out through an open hatch on the far right

variants.scene: Gears clatter as the brass pipe overhead pops open with a green hiss.
The lever clicks! Pigeons flutter above while a pneumatic cylinder rattles into view.
A glowing message canister shoots from the pipe with a loud clank.
